name: Rupashree Prakalpa
description: Provides a one-time financial grant to economically stressed families in West Bengal towards marriage expenses of their adult daughters.
descriptionHindi: गरीब परिवारों की वयस्क बेटियों के विवाह के खर्च में सहायता हेतु एकमुश्त वित्तीय अनुदान योजना।
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹25,000 credited directly into the bank account of the girl prior to her solemnized marriage.
benefitsHindi: विवाह से पूर्व कन्या के बैंक खाते में सीधे ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त वित्तीय सहायता।
eligibilityText: Resident women of West Bengal aged 18 or above whose proposed marriage is their first, with family annual income up to ₹1.50 lakh.
eligibilityTextHindi: 18 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु की कन्याएं जिनका प्रथम विवाह हो तथा परिवार की वार्षिक आय ₹1.5 लाख से कम हो।
sourceName: Rupashree Portal, Government of West Bengal
